name: ellipsoid-tessellation-scale
description: B6 ellipsoid repro: anisotropically scaled sphere topology validates, but its NURBS solid tessellation is empty at unit/large scale and leaky with about half the closed-form volume at 1e-3. The ignored ellipsoid_scale_and_mesh_postconditions_are_not_yet_qualified test carries the acceptance oracle; this bundle preserves the minimized deterministic WASM operation sequence without accepting the defective mesh as correct.
